name: Orlan-10
armament: None - ISR and artillery spotting; EW payloads on Leer-3 variant
protection: Unarmoured. Game: any hit from any calibre can down it; jamming (EW) can force it to land or drift.
visual_notes: Small high-wing propeller drone with a pusher prop at the tail end of a slim pod fuselage
Twin-boom-less single tail with V-ish stabilisers; launched from a ground catapult rail
In game: buzzes overhead before artillery arrives (a cue for the player to move)
